profile.headline: IT Systems & Application Engineer | React • NestJS • SQL • Scrum Master
profile.jobTitle: IT Support, Event Technology Coordinator, & Junior Web Developer
profile.summary:
From arpeggios to algorithms, I work at the intersection of people, processes, and software. I have hands-on experience designing and developing real-world systems that support operational workflows, data integrity, and user accountability.

I primarily work in JavaScript and TypeScript environments, with experience in React frontends and Node/NestJS backends. My recent work includes developing and implementing an internal claims management platform used by real users, where reliability, clarity, and maintainability are more important than flashy demos. I am comfortable working with databases, authentication, APIs, and data validation, and I understand how technical decisions impact users in their daily work.

I particularly enjoy translating complex or ambiguous requirements into clear and usable solutions and collaborating with stakeholders to improve the actual performance of systems in practice. I am interested in roles such as Business Systems Analyst, Business Technical Analyst, Implementation Specialist, or agile delivery roles where I can contribute to analysis, delivery, and continuous improvement.

🔗 Portfolio: https://leilahlopez.github.io

positions.title: IT Support, Event Technology Coordinator, & Junior Web Developer
positions.description:
Wearing three hats at CIESC, a nonprofit educational service center supporting schools, educators, and students across Indiana.

IT Support: First line of help for staff across the organization. Troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues, manage user accounts and devices, and keep day to day operations running smoothly so the team can focus on serving Indiana educators.

Event Technology Coordinator: Plan and run the technology behind CIESC's professional development events, conferences, and trainings. Handle A/V setup, livestream production, virtual event platforms, and on site tech support so presenters and attendees have a seamless experience.

Junior Web Developer: Build and maintain internal and public facing web tools that support CIESC's programs.

Tech: WordPress, PHP, JavaScript, React, NestJS, Tailwind CSS | MySQL, Apache | Git, GitHub | Windows, macOS, Google Workspace | Crestron, Zoom | Monday, Slack | AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc...)
positions.insights: Skills: WordPress · PHP · JavaScript · Tailwind CSS · Apache
